build_llava_model: build an LLaVA model for conditional generation with vision tower, multimodal projector, and language model
create_multimodal_projector: create a multimodal projector that maps vision features to text hidden space using two parallel linear layers
process_pixtral_images: process Pixtral image pixel inputs with per-image independent outputs for correct KV cache behavior
build_mantis_processor: build a Mantis multimodal processor that wraps image tokens with descriptive metadata tokens
initialize_vision_tower: initialize a vision tower (CLIP, Siglip, or Pixtral) up to the deepest required feature layer
